title: core.chart.data — the data of charts read from another format
description: Derived (`measured`): the series, category labels and values that the preserved chart parts of the document hold, read out so that a reader needs neither that format nor an extension node to know what a chart plots. A chart made in the application is not listed here: its `graphic` object carries the same information in `chart`. The values are the ones the source file CACHED for display (a chart linked to a workbook shows them until it is refreshed). The procedure is named `drawingml-chart-cache-1` in the node's `input_params`; its inputs are the chart parts.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload schema: the constant 1.

charts.description: One entry per chart whose data could be read, in ascending order of `source`, then of `part`.

source.description: Which chart: the value of the `ooxmlSource` property of the chart's `graphic` object in the blocks (16 hexadecimal digits). A reader matches the two strings; it needs no extension node for that.

part.description: The name of the preserved package part the data was read from (an entry of the structure node's `packageParts`), for example `word/charts/chart1.xml`. A name, not a path.

type.description: The kind of the chart's first plot, as the source names it without the word Chart: `bar` (bars or columns, see `barDirection`), `line`, `pie`, `area`, `scatter`, `doughnut`, `radar`, `bubble`, `stock`, `surface`, `ofPie`, and the three-dimensional forms `bar3D`, `line3D`, `pie3D`, `area3D`, `surface3D`. A chart that combines plots has the others in its series' `plot`.

title.description: The chart's title, when it has one of its own text. Absent: no title, or one the source computes.

barDirection.description: For bars: `col` (vertical columns) or `bar` (horizontal bars). Absent for other charts.

series.description: The data series, in the order of the source.

plot.description: The kind of plot this series belongs to (the same vocabulary as the chart's `type`).

name.description: The series' name as the legend shows it. Empty: unnamed.

categories.description: The category label of each point, as text; for a scatter or bubble plot the x value of each point, as the text the source cached. Null: the source has no label for that point. Empty: the series has no categories of its own.

values.description: The plotted value of each point (for a scatter or bubble plot: the y value), IEEE 754 binary64. Null: a gap (the source has no number for that point). Entry i belongs to `categories[i]`.
